parentChoiceHelp: No partner is selected automatically. Choose the correct parent, or indicate that they are unknown.
existingChildHelp: Existing parentage is preserved. Already linked children, ancestors and incompatible parent sets are not offered.

errors.FAMILY_PERSON_OUTSIDE_TREE: A selected person does not belong to this tree. Refresh and try again.
errors.ANCESTRY_CYCLE: This link would make a person their own ancestor. No changes were saved.
errors.SELF_RELATIONSHIP: A person cannot be their own parent or partner.
errors.PARENT_SET_CONFLICT: This child already has other parents. Correct the existing parentage explicitly before linking: no mother is replaced automatically.
errors.REQUEST_ID_REUSED: This request was already saved with different content. Refresh the tree before trying again.
errors.INVALID_PERSON_DATE: Check the dates: birth cannot be in the future and must precede the end date.
errors.INVALID_ORGANIZATION_RELATIONSHIP: Partner relationships are not available in organization charts.

reader.title: Read by family
reader.help: Each group shows the recorded parents and their shared children. A person shown in several groups still has one record.
reader.filterContext: Groups containing a matching person. Other members remain visible to preserve the family context.
reader.unlinkedHelp: These people remain in your tree. Their position does not imply any parentage.
reader.graphLegend: Solid: parentage. Dashed: partners. Crossings are not relationships.
reader.zoomHint: Reduced overview. Choose a family to read the names, or switch to Families.
reader.dateHint: Date format follows your browser settings.
